The '''Mendenbatt system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Mortex sector/Legends|Mortex sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was in close proximity to the [[Almanian system]].<ref name="Conviction">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]''</ref>
